Looking at this question, I need to consider what metabolic glycan labeling does in the context of dendritic cell vaccines.

Metabolic glycan labeling involves feeding cells modified sugar molecules that get incorporated into their surface glycans. Research has demonstrated that this technique can be used to immobilize (stabilize/"freeze") the dendritic cell membrane through crosslinking reactions (such as click chemistry with the incorporated unnatural sugars).

This membrane immobilization creates a more stable antigen-presenting structure from the dendritic cell, which:
- Preserves the antigen display on the cell surface
- Provides more sustained immune stimulation
- Enhances the overall antitumor efficacy of the dendritic cell vaccine compared to untreated DCs

Studies have shown that this approach of immobilizing the DC membrane via metabolic glycan labeling does indeed enhance antitumor immune responses.

[ANSWER]B[/ANSWER]
